findings.finding: Karnov is in an open strategic review (a sale of the company is explicitly an option, Goldman Sachs advising, no timeline). The Q3 release is the first scheduled disclosure since it opened, and any update in it would dominate the day; nothing sourced says which way it goes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When the review was announced in the Q2 report on 2026-08-20 the stock rose 10.7% despite a 3% adjusted EBITA miss. When the 2024 SEK 84 bid was withdrawn in June 2024 the stock fell more than 21%.
findings.original_quote: Styrelsen har utvärderat och kommer att fortsätta utvärdera alla tillgängliga alternativ för att maximera aktieägarvärdet (Swedish version of the release, as quoted by Finwire/Placera 2026-08-20). English original: 'The Board of Directors has and will continue to evaluate all options available to maximise shareholder value. Such options may include ... a sale of the company ... No assurances can be given ... no timeline has been established.'
findings.why_not_priced: The review is public and priced as optionality. At SEK 81.6 the stock sits just under the failed 2024 SEK 84 bid and has gained 13% in 60 days. What is not priced is how it resolves, and that cannot be known before the release, so the expected size is 0 and the range is wide.
findings.independence: https://efn.se/karnovs-svar-om-uppkopsryktet-utvarderar-alla-alternativ (EFN 2026-08-20: ABG listed Karnov as a take-private candidate in early July)

findings.finding: Buyback pace has collapsed even though capacity is left. About 100-434k shares a week in April-June 2026 became 52.5k in late July and a token 5-10k a week (1,000 shares a day) since late August. That is far under the SEK 750m cap (about 1.5m shares, roughly SEK 100m, bought under the May programmes) and the 10% holding limit (3.6% held on 6 Nov). This fits a board that is restraining purchases while a live process is under way rather than a dormant review.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none observed: buyback pace has never been a disclosed line on a results day
findings.original_quote: Karnov ... har under perioden 2 november – 6 november 2026 förvärvat totalt 5 000 egna stamaktier av serie A (Swedish twin release, https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bb65ef25efab09bcd6cdb30c399df7a93&lang=sv&src=listed). Compare 2026-06-22: 434,366 shares in one week.
findings.why_not_priced: The weekly notices are routine filings that nobody aggregates, and no preview I found mentions the slowdown. If the market read it as a sign of a live process, the stock would sit at or above the 2024 SEK 84 offer rather than at 81.6. It is still an inference: the company has not said why it slowed, and price (SEK 80 against an average of 70 in Q2) is an alternative explanation, so the size is small.
findings.independence: https://efn.se/greenoaks-capitals-innehav-i-karnov-har-minskat (EFN 2026-05-15: co-bidder Greenoaks cut its stake to 4.2%, so the 2024 consortium has partly exited, which cuts against a repeat of that bid). Nothing independent points the same way.

findings.finding: A mechanical Q3 sales estimate is about 1% under consensus. The Q3 2025 base of SEK 654m still contains EHS, divested 1 Dec 2025 (Q2's acquired effect was -6.8%, SEK -43.9m), and FX is roughly flat (EUR/SEK Q3 average 11.10 against 11.12). At H1's 2.4-3% organic growth that gives about SEK 626-632m against a 637m consensus, which would need about 3.8% organic.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 2026 sales missed by 1.3% and adj. EBITA by 3.1%, and the stock rose 10.7% on the review. In Q3 2025 the print was in line or slightly above and the stock moved +1.1%. Numbers have been subordinate to the strategic and AI narrative.

lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'Understatement is the hunters' systematic error': abs_move_pct raised from 6.0 to 7.0, the European new-numbers base. The period is not pre-released and the strategic-review tail is two-sided; the observed reaction median is about 5.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the Q2 history (EBITA miss, stock +10.7%): the sales-gap finding cut from -0.4 to -0.3.
'A narrow proxy loses ... macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': the buyback-slowdown inference cut from +0.5 to +0.4, because the company has not said why it slowed.
'In a live bid, results are noise': Karnov is not in an offer period, but the same logic applies to the review. It is kept as the dominant finding at 0 with a wide range, and p_up stays 50.
